tweets.author: Emily Chang
tweets.text: Om Malik helped shape the journalist I became, teaching me to understand the people behind companies, question the hype, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

tweets.author: Abhishek Baxi
tweets.text: Om Malik inspired a generation to believe they could write for the world. He will be remembered for his sharp journalism and the warmth he exuded.

tweets.author: Werner Vogels
tweets.text: I had great respect for Om Malik and had many deep conversations with him in the early days of Cloud Computing.

tweets.author: True Ventures
tweets.text: Remember this beautiful soul and great thinker. Om would ask us to slow down a bit and think more deeply and express our love for one another.
